preconditions.description: The length of the input string must not exceed 100 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() or c == '_' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string must only contain lowercase letters, uppercase letters, and underscores.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(stdin.count(friend) == 1 for friend in ['Danil', 'Olya', 'Slava', 'Ann', 'Nikita']) else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if the input string contains exactly one of the specified friend's names, otherwise output 'NO'.
